to be Assigned in the stretch of land from Km 17.028 to Km 41.819 (Navlakhi port-Pipaliya-Morbi) road section in 
the district of MORBI in the state of GUJARAT, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 


section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Prant officer Halvad at Morbi in 
writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 


objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 


final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 


inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

MINISTRY OF PETROLEUM AND NATURAL GAS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 8th May, 2023 


S.O. 2286(E).— whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Petroleum and 
Natural Gas, published in the Gazette No.4l4 Date : 02.02.2022 vide S.O.No.429(E) dated 3lst January, 2022 part- 
II, Section-3, Sub-Section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3 of the Petroleum and minerals pipelines 
(Acquisition of Right of User in Land) Act, 962 (50 of 962), (Hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central 
Government declared its intention to acquire the right of user in the land situated in Taluka-Dhrangadhra District 
Surendranagar in Gujarat State, specified in the schedule appended to that notification for the purpose of laying 
pipeline for the transportation of L.P.G from Kandla in the State Gujarat to Gorakhpur in the Uttar Pradesh by the IHB 
Ltd. for implementing the “Kandla-Gorakhpur LPG Pipeline Project” 


And whereas the copies of the said Gazette notification were made available to the public on 3"! March, 
2022. And whereas, Shri M. P. Patel, Competent Authority, Prant Officer, Dhrangadhara, Dist.Surendranagar, State- 
Gujarat has under sub-section () of section 6 of the said Act, has submitted his report to the Central Government. 


And whereas the Competent Authority has under sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act, has submitted 
his report to Central Government. 


And whereas, the central Government after considering the report and on being satisfied that the said land is 
required for laying the pipeline, has decided to acquire right of the user therein; 


Now therefore, in exercise of the power conferred by sub-section (l) of section 6 of the said Act, the 
Central Government hereby declares that the right of user in the land specified in the Schedule appended to this 
notification is hereby acquired for laying the pipeline; 


And further, in exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section (4) of section 6 of the said Act, the Central 
Government hereby directs that the right of user of the said land for laying the pipeline shall, instead of vesting in the 
central Government, vests on the date of publication of the declaration, in IHB Ltd., free from all encumbrances. 


THB Ltd, shall be exclusively liable for any compensation in terms of section l0 of the P&MP Act, 962 
and no suit, claim or legal proceeding would lie against the Central Government on any matter relating to pipeline.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 


New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 


S.O. 2312(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation on the stretch of 
land for development of existing NH-1 from Km 42.000 to Km 66.000 (Bandipora) as a part of Srinagar Ring Road 
Phase-II in the district of Bandipora in the Union Territory of Jammu & Kashmir, hereby declares its intention to 
acquire such land. 

Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 


notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


10 THE GAZETTE OF INDIA : EXTRAORDINARY [PART II—SEC. 3(ii)] 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Deputy Commissioner in writing 
and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being 
heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such 
further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 

The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 2284(E).—Whereas, it appears to the Central Government, that it is necessary in the public

Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), 
maintenance, management and operation of Zirakpur Bypass National Highway No. (Yet to be Assigned) Km. 0.000 
to Km. 9.000 (Starting from the junction with Chandigarh—Rajpura —Patiala NH-7 and ending at Zirakpur- Parwanoo 
NH-5) along with connecting between Yamunanagar—Panchkula NH-344 and NH-S5 in the district of Panchkula in the 
state of Haryana. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Tribune (English” and “Dainik 
Bhakar (Hindi)” both dated 07.06.2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 4316 (अ ). तारीख 14 सितम्बर 2022 जो भारत के 
राजपत्र, असाधारण, भाग Il, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा उत्तर प्रदेश राज्य के रायबरेली जिले में 
रिंग रोड (द्वितीय चरण ) के कि.मी. 0.000 से कि.मी. 21.930 तक के निर्माण (पेग्ड शोल्डर सहित २ लेन / ४ लेन बनाना 
आदि ) अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के 
अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख 25 सितम्बर 
2022 को "अमर उजाला " (हिन्दी ) और " टाइम्स ऑफ इंडिया " (अंग्रेजी) दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था और आक्षेप 
प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया है; 


और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है; 


अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पूर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए;

NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 


S.O. 2294(E).—Whereas by the notification number 4316 8.0. (E) dated 14th September 2022 of the 
Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport and Highways, published in the Gazette of India, 
Extraordinary, Part I, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intention to 


[भाग 1---खण्ड 3(ii)] भारत का राजपत्र : असाधारण 99 


acquire the land specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for construction ( two lane with paved 
shoulder/ four laning etc.,) Maintenance, management and operation of Ring Road (Phase-I]) in the stretch of land 
from Km. 0.000 to Km. 21.930 in the district of RAEBARELT in the state of UTTAR PRADESH. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Amar Ujala (Hindi)” and “Times 
Of India ( English)” both dated 25th September 2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
Competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Competent Authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the Competent Authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 
declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

का.आ. 2297(अ).--केन्द्रीय सरकार, ने, राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग अधिनियम, 1956 (1956 का 48) (जिसे इसमें इसके 
पश्चात्‌ उक्त अधिनियम कहा गया है) की धारा 3क की उपधारा (1) के अधीन जारी की गई भारत सरकार के सड़क 
परिवहन और राजमार्ग मंत्रालय की अधिसूचना संख्या का.आ. 2584 तारीख 03/06/2022, जो भारत के राजपपत्र, 
असाधारण, भाग I, खण्ड 3, उपखंड (1) में प्रकाशित की गई थी, द्वारा कर्नाटक राज्य के तुमकुर जिले में ग्रीनफील्ड हाइवे 
के कि.मी. 42.87 से कि.मी. 56.13 (स्पेशल tes एक्ज़िषन्‌ औफस अरसीकेरे) तक के राष्ट्रीय राजमार्ग के निर्माण (चौड़ा 
करने / चार लेन का बनाने, आदि), अनुरक्षण, प्रबंधन और प्रचालन के लिए उस अधिसूचना से उपाबद्ध अनुसूची में 
विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का अर्जन करने के अपने आशय की घोषणा की थी ; 


और उक्त अधिसूचना का सार उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3क की उपधारा (3) के अधीन तारीख "17 जुलाई 2022 
" को "संडे टैम्स " और "प्रजावाणी" दोनों में प्रकाशित किया गया था ; 


और आक्षेप प्राप्त हुए थे और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उन पर विचार कर लिया है और आक्षेपों को अननुज्ञात कर दिया 
है; 

और सक्षम प्राधिकारी ने उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (1) के अनुसरण में, केन्द्रीय सरकार को अपनी 
रिपोर्ट दे दी है;

अतः अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, सक्षम प्राधिकारी की उक्त रिपोर्ट प्राप्त हो जाने पर और उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ 
की उपधारा (1) द्वारा प्रदत्त शक्तियों का प्रयोग करते हुए, यह घोषणा करती है कि उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि का 
पर्वोक्त प्रयोजन के लिए अर्जन किया जाना चाहिए ; 


और अब, केन्द्रीय सरकार, उक्त अधिनियम की धारा 3घ की उपधारा (2) के अनुसरण में यह घोषणा करती है कि 
इस अधिसूचना के राजपत्र में प्रकाशन पर, उक्त अनुसूची में विनिर्दिष्ट भूमि सभी विल्लंगमों से मुक्त होकर आत्यन्तिक रूप 
से केन्द्रीय सरकार में निहित हो जाएगी ।

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 


S.O. 2297(E).— In Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road 
Transport and Highways, number 2584 (E) Dated:03/06/2022 , published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part 
II, Section 3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 1956 (48 of 
1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land 
specified in the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, 
management and operation of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 42.87 to Km. 56.13 (Special Land 
Acquisition Office Arasikere) in the district of TUMKUR in the state of KARNATAKA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “Sunday Times” and “Prajavani” 
dated 17th July,2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; 


And whereas objections have been received and the same have been considered and disallowed by the 
competent Authority; 


And whereas, in pursuance of sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has 
submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (1) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; 


And further, in pursuance of sub-section (2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby 


declares that on publication of this notification in the Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall 
vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all encumbrances.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 
S.O. 2298(E).—In Whereas by the notification of the Government of India in the Ministry of Road Transport 
and Highways numbers 2585(E) Dated:03/06/2022, published in the Gazette of India, Extraordinary, Part II, Section 
3, Sub-section (ii) issued under sub-section (l) of section 3A of the National Highway Act, 956 (48 of 956) 
(hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government declared its intension to acquire the land specified in 
the Schedule annexed to the said notification for building (widening/four-laning, etc.), maintenance, management and 


operation of Greenfield Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 56.3 to Km. 73.220 (Special Land Acquisition 
Office Arasikere) in the district of TUMKUR in the state of KARNATAKA. 


And whereas the substance of the said notification has been published in “The Hindu” and “Udayavani” both 
dated 7th July, 2022; under sub-section (3) of section 3A of the said Act; And whereas objections have been received 
and the same have been considered and disallowed by the competent Authority; And whereas, in pursuance of sub- 
section (l) of section 3D of the said Act, the competent authority has submitted its report to the Central Government; 


Now, therefore, upon receipt of the said report of the competent authority and in exercise of the powers 
conferred by the sub-section (.) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that the land 
specified in the said Schedule should be acquired for the aforesaid purpose; And further, in pursuance of sub-section 
(2) of section 3D of the said Act, the Central Government hereby declares that on publication of this notification in the 
Official Gazette, the land specified in the said Schedule shall vest absolutely in the Central Government, free from all 
encumbrances.

है;

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 


New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 


S.O. 2316(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH326 for " 
Construction of By-pass road to Rayagada Town and JK Pur Town from Km 190.975 to 205.700 on NH-326 in the 
state of Odisha on EPC Mode" , hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Tahasildar, Rayagada in writing and 
shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of being heard, 
either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making such further 
enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.

S.O. 2319(E).— In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section (1) of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 1956 (48 of 1956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of NH-361 in the 
stretch of land from Km 465.500 to Km.524.690 (Wardha-Butibori Section) in the district of NAGPUR in the state of 
MAHARASHTRA, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(1) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, Deputy Collector, Land Acquisition 
(General), Nagpur in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector 
an opportunity of being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections 
and after making such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or 
disallow the objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final.

MINISTRY OF ROAD TRANSPORT AND HIGHWAYS 
NOTIFICATION 
New Delhi, the 25th May, 2023 


S.O. 2303(E).—In exercise of powers conferred by sub-section () of section 3A of the National Highways 
Act, 956 (48 of 956) (hereinafter referred to as the said Act), the Central Government, after being satisfied that for 
the public purpose, the land, the brief description of which is given in the Schedule below, is required for building 
(widening/two lane with paved shoulder/four laning etc.,), maintenance, management and operation of Greenfield 
Highway in the stretch of land from Km. 22 to Km. 74 (collectorate, Kaimur) in the district of KAIMUR (BHABUA ) 
in the state of BIHAR, hereby declares its intention to acquire such land. 


Any person interested in the said land may, within twenty-one days from the date of publication of this 
notification in the Official Gazette, object to the use of such land for the aforesaid purpose under sub-section(l) of 
section 3C of the said Act. 


Every such objection shall be made to the Competent Authority, namely, D.C.L.R - (BHABHUA) KAIMUR 
in writing and shall set out the grounds thereof and the Competent Authority shall give the objector an opportunity of 
being heard, either in person or by a legal practitioner, and may, after hearing all such objections and after making 
such further enquiry, if any, as the Competent Authority thinks necessary, by order, either allow or disallow the 
objections. 


Any order made by the Competent Authority under sub-section (2) of section 3C of the said Act shall be 
final. 


The land plans and other details of the land to be acquired under their notification are available and can be 
inspected by the interested person at the aforesaid office of the Competent Authority.
